verdict.rationale: Greptile is itself an AI agent: users hand it code review (automatic on every PR or on demand via `greptile review`), runtime bug-hunting in a sandbox (TREX), and unit-test and diagram generation. Hands-on reports show it answering codebase questions and catching real review issues. However, the delegable tasks are narrow and review-centric, and actually fixing issues is handed off to external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Devin) rather than done by a built-in assistant. Missing for 10: a general-purpose in-product assistant that takes arbitrary user-assigned tasks, built-in execution of fixes instead of handoff to third-party agents, and independent corroboration of the test-generation and TREX delegation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Greptile is an AI code review agent that automatically reviews every pull request with complete understanding of your codebase.
Run `greptile review`, get a review of the feature branch diff in 60 seconds.
Automatically generate unit tests for new and changed code in every PR
TREX runs your PR branch in a sandbox to find the bugs that only show up at runtime.
more often than not it catches real issues and gives the author a chance to reply or fix them before another human reviews the PR.
